author: Unity
description:
Learn how to bring your browser-built Unity Studio drafts straight into the Unity Editor with your scene hierarchy, assets, and Logic scripts intact.

Unity Studio is a web-based editor designed for industries like manufacturing, automotive, healthcare, architecture, and more to build and share interactive 3D applications fast.

The new Unity Studio Importer extends the no-code Studio workflow into the full Unity Editor. Designers build interactive 3D scenes in the browser; developers pick the work up in the Editor with everything preserved, and Studio Logic scripts are automatically converted into C# - ready to extend with custom code, profiling, and builds for any platform Unity supports.

In this tutorial we take you from setup through import, verification, troubleshooting, and production-ready customization.

🔗 Read the docs: https://on.unity.com/StudioImporter_Docs
🔗 Claim your free 30 day trial: https://on.unity.com/UnityStudio
🔗 Unity Studio is part of Unity Cloud. Get started
title: Unity Studio Importer
